newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to retire to 130.00/129.85 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to retire to 130.00/129.85 support.

text.p: Italian BTP futures traded on LIFFE will continue to retrace the early June rally, falling to test the 130.00 psychological level, backed up by the June 2 high at 129.85, technical analysts said on Monday.
"Below there, things will get more tricky," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "It will head to 129.49, the May 30 high."
September BTP futures rallied from a low of 128.60 on May 30 to a high of 130.90 on June 3.
They were trading down 11 basis points at 130.12 by 0840 GMT, after earlier setting a low of 130.04.

Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said a break below the 130.00 level would put daily indicators on the verge of crossing lower, and target a deeper retracement toward 129.75 and 129.48.
"The BTP needs to rally through downtrend at 130.64 over the next one to three days to keep the momentum positive," Deutsche analysts said in a research note.

Celaya said the major downside level was 128.60, the low on May 30. On the upside, the 130.90 high was a clear barrier, while the high so far in Monday's session at 130.60 was also likely to prove difficult to break.
Further out 131.86, the contract high set on May 21 was key resistance, analysts said. Before the contract gets there, the mid-May highs at 131.55 and 131.66 form a resistance zone.
At the short end, September Eurolira futures were expected to find short term support at 93.27, and have the potential to bounce to last week's highs near 93.45.
September Eurolira futures were down 0.02 at 93.31 by 0910 GMT.
